header.title: Extreme-Market Risk Radar & Reconciliation Guard
header.subtitle: Deterministic millisecond-level guards · Live exchange position reconciliation & dead man's switch monitoring

kill.confirmMessage:
Trigger the global emergency kill switch?
This immediately broadcasts cancel-all orders to every exchange and force-stops all strategy workers.
kill.success: Kill switch triggered. All open orders have been canceled.

overall.triggered: Extreme-market hard guard triggered — entries blocked
overall.symbolDesc: Symbol: {{symbol}} · On any 1m flash spike, cross-exchange spread isolation or macro blackout window, new position proposals are rejected within milliseconds

reconcile.title: Exchange Position Reconciler (ExchangeReconciler) & Dead Man's Switch
reconcile.notRun: Not reconciled yet (use the button on the right)
reconcile.resumed: Reconciliation clean — bot resumed from paused/circuit-broken state!
reconcile.clean: Exchange and local positions match exactly — no ghost positions.
reconcile.autoPaused: . The bot was auto-paused to protect capital!
reconcile.resumeRefused: Reconciliation clean, but the bot could not be resumed: {{reason}}

r1.name: Macro Event Blackout Window
r1.desc: Blocks new positions during the blackout window around major macro events (calendar: config/macro_events.yaml).

r2.name: 1m Price Spike Guard
r2.desc: Rejects entries when the latest candle's range exceeds the flash-spike circuit-breaker threshold.

r3.name: Pin Bar Liquidation Detector
r3.desc: Flags extreme upper/lower wicks using the latest candle's wick-to-body ratio.

r4.name: Spread & Liquidity Guard (bps)
r4.desc: Monitors the live cross-exchange spread in bps and isolates the market when liquidity deteriorates.

r5.name: Funding Squeeze Alert
r5.desc: Warns of crowded positioning when annualized funding is below -20% or above +40%.

r6.name: Portfolio Exposure Guard
r6.desc: Caps total registered portfolio exposure and blocks offsetting (wash) positions across bots.

r7.name: Gateway RPC Latency & Heartbeat
r7.desc: Measures data-gateway RPC latency and the dead man's switch heartbeat; isolates on gateway failure.
